verdict.rationale: Data-use and training controls are a fair question for a cloud speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented training opt-out or no-training data policy. HIPAA-compliant processing [rev-ai-docs-15] and on-prem deployment [rev-ai-docs-19] are adjacent privacy features, not a control over whether data is used to train models, so they earn no credit.
